name: cronboard
description: GNOME Shell extension for managing your cron jobs from the top panel

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && cp metadata.json stylesheet.css dist/ && mkdir dist/icons && cp icons/cronboard-symbolic.svg dist/icons/
scripts.nested: MUTTER_DEBUG_DUMMY_MODE_SPECS=1280x800 dbus-run-session -- sh -c 'gnome-shell --nested --wayland & sleep 3; gnome-extensions enable cronboard@seniru-dilmith.github.io; wait'
scripts.pack: npm run build && gnome-extensions pack dist --extra-source=icons --extra-source=lib --extra-source=logview.js --force
